### Leave-one-out alternates (blind)

| held out | scored | VIOLATED | UNKNOWN | tasks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| alternate[0] | 12 | 1 | 0 | canonicalization_signed_path_01 |
| alternate[1] | 12 | 0 | 0 | — |
| alternate[2] | 12 | 0 | 0 | — |

`canonicalization_signed_path_01` / `alternate[0]` was adjudicated against the written contract, not
against the majority: it drops the `canonicalize(...) is not None` check, so a percent-encoded
request whose both sides canonicalize to `None` compares equal and is accepted. The contract says a
request target is accepted *only when it is free of percent-encoding*, so this is a true reject, not
a precision failure.

## A2 — `envcert` two-level certification

| check | result |
|---|---|
| clean packs reaching `pack_integrity` | 5/5 |
| D1 leaked metadata → C2 FAIL | caught |
| D2 weak verifier → C4 FAIL | caught |
| D3 drifted deployment → verify exit 2 | caught |

The two-level rule held: with no policy evaluation the tool issues `pack_integrity` only, and
`policy_tested` requires real generated candidates from a named configuration with at least
`min_audited` audited accepts. The D2 run shows the swap from `property` to `weak` failing C4.

## What this does not establish

- Property cases are generated by code written with knowledge of the task *contracts*; the guard
  against generator tuning is the blind leave-one-out alternate, not an independent author.
- The expression corpus is 12 hand-written tasks; the native case covers one repository (authlib).
- Reset latency was measured on two service images. The injected pack source is not inside those
  images, so this measures substrate reset cost, not a per-pack end-to-end environment reset.
- KVM is absent on the benchmark host: hardware-accelerated VM snapshot restore is not measured, and
  software emulation is not a comparable path.
- Track B ran only its expression arm (`results/B1.md`): selection drift on the 12-task control was
  **not measurable** — 1 refutation across 112 Tier-1 accepts — because these models solve the corpus.
  The native-pack arm (3 packs x 3 models x 32) and any GRPO arm did not run.
